title: Clockwork Ghost Horse
description: A white line-art spectral horse in mid-leap with an open mouth, its body filled with roses, flowers, and clock faces. A broken birdcage floats near its back against a dark, painterly background of deep blue, green, and black with dripping paint effects and hanging floral vines.
prompt: A spectral white line-art horse rearing with open mouth, its body composed of roses, flowers and multiple clock faces. A broken birdcage floats behind it. Dark moody background with dripping paint, hanging vines and flowers at the top. Surreal symbolic style with strong white outlines on deep blue, green and black painterly textures.
